name: boomi-standards
description: Checks Boomi Companion's components against the team's standards before they are created, pushed or deployed

enforce.title: Block components that break the standards
enforce.description: Refuse a Companion create, push or deploy while a component has an error; off, findings are only reported to Claude

rulesFile.title: Standards file
rulesFile.description: The team's standards, relative to the session's working directory; without it the default rules apply

componentsDir.title: Components folder
componentsDir.description: Where Boomi Companion keeps component XML; /standards check with no files checks everything under it
